summary: Verified the fix for the CANCEL / SAVE buttons in the tool detail EDIT mode. Logged in as PRO account (mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321!) in default Steel theme, opened an existing inventory item, used the 3-dots menu → Edit. Measured the bottom edit bar: CANCEL bbox 165x38, SAVE bbox 187x38 (was 48px before), editBar paddingTop 8px / paddingBottom 12px / barHeight 59px (matches the spec: padding 12→8 / 24→12). Both buttons are fully visible (not clipped), the bottom bar is noticeably shorter and more compact, and both buttons are functional — CANCEL exits edit mode without saving, SAVE persists changes and returns to view mode (editBar count goes from 1 → 0 in each case).
critical_code_review_comments: app/tool/[id].tsx is 4047 lines — well above the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the edit-mode forms, the repair/claim modal, the for-sale poster generator, and the PDF export into dedicated modules.

toolDetailStyles.ts has duplicated entries (e.g. category spec pair pushed twice around lines 1317-1318 in the PDF export, and duplicated histRow/histName/histDate keys inside the same StyleSheet between lines 376-383 and 1644-1668) — minor but worth a cleanup pass.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused the existing PRO account's inventory (item 'Injector seal installer kit').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via testIDs auth-email / auth-password / auth-submit. Tool detail has NO inline Edit button — EDIT is reached via tool-menu-btn (top-right 3 dots) → menu-edit. The bottom action bar uses testIDs edit-cancel-bar / edit-save-bar.
rca_of_issue: Previous attempts only trimmed editBar padding; CANCEL/SAVE inherited styles.btnGhost / styles.btnPrimary which have fixed height:48 (toolDetailStyles.ts lines 554-573). Fix: inline override height:38 on both TouchableOpacity styles in app/tool/[id].tsx (edit-cancel-bar / edit-save-bar) and editBar paddingTop 12→8, paddingBottom 24→12 in toolDetailStyles.ts. Verified via Playwright bounding-box measurements.
